-From a22b0dd63266269cb3f998449740fbe9db092615 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

+From 5013bd1e23dc00d32cea219b48d4ba602acb700e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>
+Date: Wed, 18 Dec 2024 09:02:28 +0100
+Subject: [PATCH] x86/static-call: fix 32-bit build
 
+commit 349f0086ba8b2a169877d21ff15a4d9da3a60054 upstream.
+
+In 32-bit x86 builds CONFIG_STATIC_CALL_INLINE isn't set, leading to
+static_call_initialized not being available.
+
+Define it as "0" in that case.
+
+Reported-by: Stephen Rothwell <sfr@canb.auug.org.au>
+Fixes: 0ef8047b737d ("x86/static-call: provide a way to do very early static-call updates")
+Signed-off-by: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>
+Acked-by: Peter Zijlstra (Intel) <peterz@infradead.org>
+Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>
+Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>
 ---
- include/linux/static_call.h | 6 ++++++
- 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+)
+ include/linux/static_call.h | 7 ++++++-
+ 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
 
 diff --git a/include/linux/static_call.h b/include/linux/static_call.h
-index 78a77a4ae0ea..59700baca14a 100644
+index 785980af89729..78a77a4ae0ea8 100644
 --- a/include/linux/static_call.h
 +++ b/include/linux/static_call.h
-@@ -162,6 +162,8 @@ extern void arch_static_call_transform(void *site, void *tramp, void *func, bool
+@@ -138,7 +138,6 @@
+ #ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL
+ #include <asm/static_call.h>
  
- extern int static_call_initialized;
+-extern int static_call_initialized;
+ /*
+  * Either @site or @tramp can be NULL.
+  */
+@@ -161,6 +160,8 @@ extern void arch_static_call_transform(void *site, void *tramp, void *func, bool
+ 
+ #ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL_INLINE
  
 +extern int static_call_initialized;
 +
  extern int __init static_call_init(void);
  
  extern void static_call_force_reinit(void);
-@@ -229,6 +231,8 @@ extern long __static_call_return0(void);
+@@ -226,6 +227,8 @@ extern long __static_call_return0(void);
  
- #define static_call_initialized 0
+ #elif defined(CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL)
  
 +#define static_call_initialized 0
 +
  static inline int static_call_init(void) { return 0; }
  
  #define DEFINE_STATIC_CALL(name, _func)					\
-@@ -287,6 +291,8 @@ extern long __static_call_return0(void);
+@@ -282,6 +285,8 @@ extern long __static_call_return0(void);
  
- #define static_call_initialized 0
+ #else /* Generic implementation */
  
 +#define static_call_initialized 0
 +
  static inline int static_call_init(void) { return 0; }
  
  static inline long __static_call_return0(void)
